title: Hermes Agent Tutorial (4): A Deep Dive into Gateway Message Flow
html:
A Deep Dive into Hermes Gateway Message Flow

Chapter objective: Understand how Hermes connects to Telegram, Discord, WeChat, and other platforms, and how messages enter the core from outside
Prerequisites: Hermes Agent Tutorial (2): System Architecture and Design
Documentation: https://github.com/Eva-Dengyh/AI-Fullstack-Notes

Contents

  • 1. Where the Gateway Fits in the Architecture
  • 2. The Core Problem: Why We Need the Adapter Pattern
  • 3. Designing a Unified Message Format
  • 4. The Telegram Adapter in Detail
  • 5. Gateway Core: Message Dispatch and Routing
  • 6. Session Management: Conversation Persistence
  • 7. Tracing the Complete Message Flow
  • 8. Handling Slash Commands

1. Where the Gateway Fits in the Architecture

The Gateway sits at the very front of the Hermes architecture:

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      用户（你）                              │
│          终端  /  Telegram  /  Discord  /  微信  / ...        │
└──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                           │  各平台私有协议
                           ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Hermes Gateway                            │
│                                                              │
│   ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  │
│   │ Telegram │  │ Discord  │  │  Slack   │  │   Email  │  │
│   │ 适配器    │  │ 适配器    │  │ 适配器    │  │  适配器   │  │
│   └────┬─────┘  └────┬─────┘  └────┬─────┘  └────┬─────┘  │
│        └─────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────┘          │
│                         │                                    │
│                  ┌──────▼──────┐                             │
│                  │  run.py      │  ← Gateway Core            │
│                  │  统一消息格式  │                             │
│                  │  Session 管理│                            │
│                  └──────┬──────┘                             │
└──────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────┘
                           │  统一消息对象
                           ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Hermes Agent Core                        │
│                    run_agent.py                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Gateway = the “customs checkpoint” for incoming and outgoing messages, responsible for all external communication.

2. The Core Problem: Why Do We Need the Adapter Pattern?

2.1 Differences Between Platform Message Protocols

Without the adapter pattern, our code would look like this:

# ❌ 噩梦般的耦合代码
async def handle_message(platform, message):
    if platform == "telegram":
        chat_id = message["message"]["chat"]["id"]
        text = message["message"]["text"]
        await send_telegram_message(chat_id, reply)
    
    elif platform == "discord":
        channel_id = message["d"]["channel_id"]
        content = message["d"]["content"]
        await send_discord_message(channel_id, reply)
    
    elif platform == "wechat":
        from_user = message["xml"]["FromUserName"]
        content = message["xml"]["Content"]
        await send_wechat_message(from_user, reply)
    
    # 加一个新平台 → 这里就要改代码 → 风险极大

2.2 The Core Idea of the Adapter Pattern

Adapter = converter. Each platform's adapter has two responsibilities:

1. 接收：将平台特定格式 → 统一格式
2. 发送：将统一格式 → 平台特定格式
Telegram 消息格式                    统一消息格式
{"message": {"chat": {...}}}    →  {user_id, text, platform, ...}
                                      ↑
                                  Discord 适配器
{"d": {"channel_id": ...,        {user_id, text, platform, ...}
       "content": "..."}}
                                      ↑
                                  微信 适配器
{"xml": {"FromUserName": ...,    {user_id, text, platform, ...}
         "Content": "..."}}

2.3 Benefits of the Adapter Pattern

ScenarioWithout adaptersWith adapters
Adding a platformModify Gateway CoreWrite a new adapter file; Core stays unchanged
Platform API upgradeModify Gateway CoreModify only the adapter
Adapter bugAffects the entire systemAffects only that platform
TestingRequires real APIsCan use mocks

3. Designing a Unified Message Format

3.1 Designing the Unified Message Object

Gateway Core defines a platform-independent message format:

# gateway/run.py 或 gateway/message.py

@dataclass
class UnifiedMessage:
    """所有平台适配器统一使用的消息格式。"""
    
    # 发送者信息
    user_id: str           # 用户唯一标识（在 Hermes 内部）
    platform: str          # 来源平台："telegram" / "discord" / ...
    
    # 消息内容
    text: str               # 消息文本
    attachments: List[Dict]  # 附件（图片/文件等）
    
    # 会话信息
    chat_id: str            # 平台原生的会话 ID
    thread_id: Optional[str]  # 话题 ID（支持 Discord thread 等）
    
    # 元数据
    message_id: str         # 平台原生的消息 ID（用于回复引用）
    timestamp: datetime      # 消息时间
    
    # 特殊标记
    is_bot_command: bool     # 是否是 slash 命令（如 /help）
    raw: Any                 # 平台原生消息体（保留原始数据）

3.2 The Unified Message Lifecycle

消息进来 → 适配器解析 → UnifiedMessage
    │
    │  Gateway Core 处理
    │
    ▼
AIAgent.run_conversation(message.text)
    │
    │  AIAgent 返回回复
    │
    ▼
回复（统一格式）
    │
    │  适配器发送
    │
    ▼
平台原生消息格式 → 发送到用户

4. The Telegram Adapter in Detail

4.1 How Telegram Bots Work

Telegram bots receive messages through Long Polling:

Hermes  ──HTTP GET──▶  Telegram Server
◀──等待中（最多几十秒）───
        │
        │ 有新消息
        ▼
◀──返回新消息列表────────
        │
        ▼
Hermes 处理消息
        │
        ▼
Hermes ─-HTTP POST──▶  Telegram Server  ──▶ 用户手机

Long Polling = the client keeps asking the server “Any new messages?” and the server waits until a message arrives before responding.

4.2 Core Logic of the Telegram Adapter

# gateway/platforms/telegram.py（简化版）

class TelegramAdapter:
    def __init__(self, bot_token: str):
        self.bot_token = bot_token
        self.api_url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{bot_token}"
    
    # ========== 接收消息（Long Polling）==========
    
    async def get_updates(self, offset: int = None, timeout: int = 30):
        """
        从 Telegram 获取新消息。
        这是适配器的"耳朵"。
        """
        params = {"timeout": timeout, "allowed_updates": "message"}
        if offset:
            params["offset"] = offset
        
        response = await self._http_get(f"{self.api_url}/getUpdates", params)
        return response["result"]
    
    async def handle_updates(self):
        """
        主循环：持续获取并处理新消息。
        """
        update_id = 0
        while True:
            updates = await self.get_updates(offset=update_id)
            
            for update in updates:
                # 1. 解析 Telegram 原生格式
                tg_message = update["message"]
                
                # 2. 转换成统一格式
                unified = self._to_unified(tg_message)
                
                # 3. 交给 Gateway Core 处理
                await gateway_core.on_message(unified)
                
                # 4. 更新 offset（防止重复处理）
                update_id = update["update_id"] + 1
    
    # ========== 发送消息 ==========
    
    async def send_message(self, chat_id: int, text: str, reply_to=None):
        """
        发送消息给用户。
        这是适配器的"嘴"。
        """
        payload = {
            "chat_id": chat_id,
            "text": text,
            "parse_mode": "Markdown",
        }
        if reply_to:
            payload["reply_to_message_id"] = reply_to
        
        await self._http_post(f"{self.api_url}/sendMessage", payload)
    
    # ========== 格式转换 ==========
    
    def _to_unified(self, tg_message: dict) -> UnifiedMessage:
        """
        Telegram 格式 → 统一格式。
        """
        return UnifiedMessage(
            user_id=str(tg_message["from"]["id"]),
            platform="telegram",
            text=tg_message.get("text", ""),
            chat_id=str(tg_message["chat"]["id"]),
            message_id=str(tg_message["message_id"]),
            timestamp=datetime.fromtimestamp(tg_message["date"]),
            is_bot_command=tg_message.get("text", "").startswith("/"),
            raw=tg_message,
        )

4.3 The Complete Message-Sending Process

用户："帮我查一下天气"

Telegram 服务器 ──收到用户消息──▶ Hermes Telegram 适配器
                                      │
                                      ▼ 解析成 UnifiedMessage
                                 Gateway Core
                                      │
                                      ▼ AIAgent 处理
                                 AI 回复："北京今天晴天，25°C"
                                      │
                                      ▼ 适配器发送
                                 Telegram API
                                      │
                                      ▼
                                 用户手机屏幕

5. Gateway Core: Message Dispatch and Routing

5.1 Responsibilities of Gateway Core

Gateway Core (gateway/run.py) is the heart of the entire Gateway:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│            Gateway Core (run.py)            │
│                                             │
│  职责1：管理 Session                          │
│    - 用户第一次发消息 → 创建新 Session         │
│    - 用户继续发消息 → 找到已有 Session         │
│    - 保存会话历史到 SQLite                    │
│                                             │
│  职责2：路由消息                              │
│    - 普通消息 → 发给 AIAgent                  │
│    - Slash 命令 → 调用对应命令处理器           │
│                                             │
│  职责3：管理 Agent 实例                       │
│    - 每个 Session 对应一个 AIAgent            │
│    - 控制 Agent 的生命周期                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────┘

5.2 Session Management

Session = a complete conversation context.

# gateway/session.py

class SessionStore:
    """
    管理所有会话。
    每个 chat_id + platform 组合对应一个 Session。
    """
    
    def __init__(self, db_path: str):
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        self._sessions: Dict[str, AIAgent] = {}
        # 内存缓存：session_id → AIAgent 实例
    
    def get_or_create_session(
        self,
        platform: str,
        chat_id: str,
        user_id: str,
    ) -> tuple[str, AIAgent]:
        """
        获取或创建 Session。
        返回 (session_id, agent_instance)。
        """
        session_id = f"{platform}:{chat_id}:{user_id}"
        
        if session_id not in self._sessions:
            # 创建新 Session
            self._sessions[session_id] = AIAgent(
                session_id=session_id,
                platform=platform,
            )
            # 从 SQLite 恢复历史（如果有）
            self._load_history(session_id)
        
        return session_id, self._sessions[session_id]
    
    def save_session(self, session_id: str):
        """把 Session 状态保存到 SQLite"""
        agent = self._sessions.get(session_id)
        if agent:
            messages = agent.get_conversation_history()
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sessions VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (session_id, json.dumps(messages), datetime.now())
            )
            self.db.commit()

5.3 Message Routing

# gateway/run.py（简化版）

async def on_message(unified: UnifiedMessage):
    """
    处理一条统一格式的消息。
    这是 Gateway Core 的主入口。
    """
    
    # ========== Step 1：处理 Slash 命令 ==========
    if unified.is_bot_command:
        command = unified.text.split()[0][1:]  # "/help" → "help"
        await handle_slash_command(command, unified)
        return
    
    # ========== Step 2：获取或创建 Session ==========
    session_id, agent = session_store.get_or_create_session(
        platform=unified.platform,
        chat_id=unified.chat_id,
        user_id=unified.user_id,
    )
    
    # ========== Step 3：发给 AIAgent ==========
    response = await agent.run_conversation(unified.text)
    
    # ========== Step 4：把回复发回平台 ==========
    await platform_adapter.send_message(
        chat_id=unified.chat_id,
        text=response,
    )
    
    # ========== Step 5：保存 Session ==========
    session_store.save_session(session_id)

6. Session Management: Conversation Persistence

6.1 Why Do We Need Persistence?

Without persistence:

用户关掉手机 → Hermes 重启 → 用户再打开 → Hermes 不认识他了

With persistence:

用户关掉手机 → Hermes 保存 Session 到 SQLite → 重启
用户再打开 → 从 SQLite 恢复 Session → 继续对话，像没断过一样

6.2 SQLite Storage Structure

CREATE TABLE sessions (
    session_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,    -- "telegram:123456:user789"
    messages    TEXT,                 -- JSON 格式的对话历史
    updated_at  TEXT                  -- 最后更新时间
);

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE sessions_fts 
USING fts5(session_id, messages);
-- FTS5 = 全文搜索索引，用于"搜索历史对话"

6.3 The Complete Session Lifecycle

用户发消息 ①
    │
    ▼
SessionStore.get_or_create_session()
    │ session 存在？──是──▶ 从 SQLite 读消息历史
    │                   │
    │                   ▼
    │                重建 AIAgent.messages
    │
    └──不存在？──▶ 创建新 AIAgent，messages = []
    │
    ▼
AIAgent.run_conversation(message.text)
    │
    ▼
回复给用户，同时：
    │
    ▼
session_store.save_session()
    │
    ▼
messages[] → JSON → SQLite.updated_at

7. Tracing the Complete Message Flow

7.1 The Full Path from Sending a Message to Receiving a Reply

用户（手机）                               Hermes 服务器
   │                                          │
   │  ① 发送消息                               │
   │ ──────────────────────────────────────▶  │
   │                                          │
   │                                     ② Telegram 适配器
   │                                        Long Polling
   │                                     接收消息，解析
   │                                          │
   │                                          ▼
   │                                     ③ 转换 UnifiedMessage
   │                                          │
   │                                          ▼
   │                                     ④ Gateway Core
   │                                     检查 Slash 命令？
   │                                     否 → 继续
   │                                          │
   │                                          ▼
   │                                     ⑤ SessionStore
   │                                     获取/创建 Session
   │                                     恢复 AIAgent
   │                                          │
   │                                          ▼
   │                                     ⑥ AIAgent.run_conversation()
   │                                          │
   │                                          │ AI 循环
   │                                          ▼
   │                                     ⑦ 工具调用（可能多次）
   │                                     registry.dispatch(...)
   │                                          │
   │                                          ▼
   │                                     ⑧ 获得最终回复
   │                                          │
   │  ⑨ 发送回复                               │
   │ ◀──────────────────────────────────────  │
   │                                          │
   │                                     ⑩ SessionStore 保存
   │                                          │

7.2 A Concrete Example: Asking Hermes a Question on WeChat

用户（微信）        Hermes               AIAgent              工具系统
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │ "北京天气怎样？"   │                    │                     │
   │ ───────────────▶ │                    │                     │
   │                  │ 适配器解析           │                     │
   │                  │──────────────────▶ UnifiedMessage         │
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │                  │                    │  Session 管理       │
   │                  │                    │────────────────────▶ │
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │                  │                    │ 发 AI API           │
   │                  │                    │←────────────────────│
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │                  │                    │ tool_call: weather  │
   │                  │                    │────────────────────▶ │
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │                  │                    │◀────────────────────│
   │                  │                    │ 返回天气 JSON        │
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │                  │                    │ 再发 AI API          │
   │                  │                    │←────────────────────│
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │                  │                    │ 最终回复             │
   │  "北京晴天25°C"   │◀─────────────────── │                     │
   │ ◀─────────────── │                    │                     │
   │                  │                    │                     │
   │                  │ Session 保存        │                     │
   │                  │──────────────────▶  │                     │

8. Handling Slash Commands

8.1 What Are Slash Commands?

On Telegram/Discord, when a user enters commands such as /help, /model, Hermes needs to handle them specially rather than send them to the AI as ordinary messages.

8.2 Slash Command Processing

async def on_message(unified: UnifiedMessage):
    
    # 检测是否是 Slash 命令
    if unified.is_bot_command:
        # "/model claude-3" → ("model", ["claude-3"])
        parts = unified.text.split()
        command_name = parts[0][1:]  # 去掉 /
        command_args = parts[1:]
        
        # 从命令注册表找到处理器
        handler = COMMAND_REGISTRY.get(command_name)
        
        if handler:
            await handler(unified, *command_args)
        else:
            await platform_adapter.send_message(
                unified.chat_id,
                f"Unknown command: /{command_name}\nUse /help for available commands."
            )
        
        return  # Slash 命令不走 AIAgent
    
    # 普通消息 → 走 AIAgent
    ...

8.3 Command Registry

Commands are centrally defined in hermes_cli/commands.py:

# hermes_cli/commands.py

COMMAND_REGISTRY = {
    "help": handle_help,
    "model": handle_model_switch,
    "new": handle_new_conversation,
    "reset": handle_reset,
    "compress": handle_compress,
    "usage": handle_usage,
    "skills": handle_skills,
    "tools": handle_tools_config,
    # ... 更多命令
}

# 每个命令有自己的处理器
async def handle_model_switch(unified, *args):
    """切换 AI 模型"""
    if not args:
        return await send(unified.chat_id, "Usage: /model <model_name>")
    
    new_model = args[0]
    session_store.set_model(unified.session_id, new_model)
    await send(unified.chat_id, f"Model switched to {new_model}")

Summary

By the end of this chapter, you should understand:

  • The Gateway's position and responsibilities in the Hermes architecture
  • The core problem solved by the adapter pattern
  • The design of a unified message format
  • The Telegram adapter's Long Polling mechanism
  • How Gateway Core routes messages
  • Session management: memory + SQLite persistence
  • The complete message flow from user to Agent and back
  • How slash commands are handled

Originally published on the Preface Lab WeChat account: Read the original WeChat article.

title: Hermes Agent Tutorial (5): A Deep Dive into Memory and Skills
html:
A Deep Dive into Hermes Memory and Skills

Chapter goal: Understand how Hermes remembers information across sessions and how Skills accumulate experience
Prerequisite: Hermes Agent Tutorial (2): System Architecture and Design
Documentation: https://github.com/Eva-Dengyh/AI-Fullstack-Notes

Contents

  • 1. What Problem Does Memory Solve?
  • 2. Memory-system Architecture
  • 3. How Memories Are Extracted and Stored
  • 4. How Memories Are Recalled
  • 5. Skills: Beyond Ordinary Memory
  • 6. Skill Storage Format
  • 7. Retrieving and Invoking Skills
  • 8. How Skills Evolve
  • 9. Memory vs. Skills: Comparison

1. What Problem Does Memory Solve?

1.1 The Fatal Flaw of Standard Agents

Most AI agents have a fatal problem: they remember nothing once a conversation ends.

第 1 天：
用户：我是 Eva，在AA科技工作
Hermes：好的 Eva，我记住了！
第 1 天结束，关闭 Hermes

第 2 天：
用户：我叫什么名字？
Hermes：抱歉，我不知道...
用户：我在哪工作？
Hermes：抱歉，我也不记得了...

This happens because:

  • AI models have limited context windows
  • Conversation history is truncated when it becomes too long
  • Information is completely lost after a session ends

1.2 Hermes's Solution

Hermes has a persistent memory system that stores important information on disk:

第 1 天：                               第 2 天：
用户：我是 Eva，在AA科技工作           │
      │                                  │
      ▼ 记忆工具提取并存储               ▼ 从磁盘读取
~/.hermes/memory/                    ~/.hermes/memory/
└── user_eva.md                       └── user_eva.md
     - name: Eva                            - name: Eva
     - company: AA科技                     - company: AA科技
                                         │
                                         ▼ AIAgent 自动加载
用户：我叫什么名字？                      │
      │ ◀───────────────────────────── AI 知道 Eva 叫什么

2. Memory-system Architecture

2.1 What Components Does It Include?

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              记忆系统（memory system）                 │
│                                                       │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  memory_tool.py                              │   │
│  │  对话内的工具：记忆的读写接口                  │   │
│  │  用户说"记住 X" → memory_tool 存储           │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                         +                             │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  memory_manager.py                           │   │
│  │  记忆的自动管理：什么时候记、记什么、怎么召回   │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                         +                             │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  ~/.hermes/memory/                           │   │
│  │  持久化存储：Markdown 文件                    │   │
│  │  ├── user_eva.md                             │   │
│  │  ├── preferences.md                          │   │
│  │  └── facts_travel.md                         │   │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

2.2 Types of Memory

Hermes stores several types of memory:

USER.md        → 用户个人信息（名字、职业、偏好）
MEMORY.md      → 事实性记忆（重要事件、项目信息）
preferences.md → 用户偏好（编程语言、咖啡口味）
skills/*.md    → 经验性记忆（Skills，见下一节）

2.3 Memory Storage Format

Memories are stored as Markdown files in the ~/.hermes/memory/ directory:

# user_eva.md

**Name:** Eva
**Company:** AA科技
**Role:** AI 全栈开发工程师
**Timezone:** Asia/Shanghai

**Preferences:**
- Language: Python
- Editor: Cursor
- Coffee: 不喜欢美式咖啡

**Personal:**
- 喜欢吃麻辣火锅
- 常用编程语言：Python

---
Last updated: 2025-03-24

3. How Memories Are Extracted and Stored

3.1 Two Ways to Remember

主动记忆：用户明确说"记住 X"
  用户："帮我记住，我喜欢用 Cursor 编辑器"
    → Hermes 调用 memory_tool 存储

被动记忆：Hermes 自动提取
  用户说了一段话，Hermes 自动判断"这值得记住"
    → 自动触发存储逻辑

3.2 Implementing memory_tool

tools/memory_tool.py provides two core operations:

def memory_tool(action: str, target: str, content: str = None, old_text: str = None):
    """
    action: "add" | "replace" | "remove"
    target: "user" | "memory" | "preferences"
    content: 新内容（add/replace 时）
    old_text: 要替换的旧文本（replace/remove 时）
    """
    
    if action == "add":
        # 新增记忆
        filepath = get_memory_path(target)
        with open(filepath, "a") as f:
            f.write(f"\n## {datetime.now().date()}\n")
            f.write(f"{content}\n")
        
        return json.dumps({"success": True, "message": "记忆已保存"})
    
    elif action == "replace":
        # 替换记忆
        filepath = get_memory_path(target)
        content = read_file(filepath)
        new_content = content.replace(old_text, content)
        write_file(filepath, new_content)
        
        return json.dumps({"success": True, "message": "记忆已更新"})
    
    elif action == "remove":
        # 删除记忆
        ...

3.3 Deciding What to Remember

Hermes does not remember everything. It intelligently decides what is worth retaining:

# memory_manager.py

def should_remember(text: str) -> bool:
    """
    判断用户说的这段话是否值得存储为持久记忆。
    """
    # 提取潜在的事实
    facts = extract_facts(text)  # 命名实体识别
    
    # 以下情况值得记住：
    # 1. 包含个人信息（名字、职业、地点）
    # 2. 用户明确说"记住..."
    # 3. 包含偏好（喜欢/讨厌...）
    # 4. 包含重要约定或计划
    
    return len(facts) >= 2  # 至少包含 2 个实体才值得记住

4. How Memories Are Recalled

4.1 When Recall Happens

Memories are loaded into AIAgent's system prompt at the start of every conversation:

Session 启动
    │
    ▼
memory_manager 读取 ~/.hermes/memory/
    │
    ▼
构建"用户信息块"，注入系统提示词
    │
    ▼
AIAgent 在回答时自动知道这些信息

4.2 Code for Recall and Injection

# agent/memory_manager.py

def build_memory_context_block(user_id: str) -> str:
    """
    读取用户记忆，构建注入给 AIAgent 的文本块。
    """
    blocks = []
    
    # 读取用户信息
    user_file = get_memory_path("user")
    if os.path.exists(user_file):
        blocks.append(f"## User Information\n{read_file(user_file)}")
    
    # 读取一般记忆
    memory_file = get_memory_path("memory")
    if os.path.exists(memory_file):
        blocks.append(f"## Memorable Facts\n{read_file(memory_file)}")
    
    # 读取偏好
    prefs_file = get_memory_path("preferences")
    if os.path.exists(prefs_file):
        blocks.append(f"## User Preferences\n{read_file(prefs_file)}")
    
    return "\n\n".join(blocks)

4.3 The Result of Memory Injection

Memory content is injected when AIAgent assembles its system prompt:

系统提示词：
...
## User Information
- Name: Eva
- Company: AA科技
- Role: AI 全栈开发工程师

## User Preferences
- Language: Python
- Editor: Cursor
- Dislikes: 美式咖啡

## Memorable Facts
- 喜欢吃麻辣火锅
- 养过一只叫卷卷的狗

---
Now you can answer the user knowing this context.

5. Skills: Beyond Ordinary Memory

5.1 What Are Skills?

Skills = experiential memory.

Ordinary memory stores facts ("Eva likes Python"), while Skills store experience ("how I solved a Python bug Eva encountered").

Memory（事实记忆）:
  "用户叫 Eva"
  "用户在AA科技工作"
  "用户喜欢吃麻辣火锅"

Skills（经验记忆）:
  "当用户让我调试 Python 时：
   1. 先让用户提供完整错误信息
   2. 检查是否是 ImportError / SyntaxError / IndexError
   3. 按类型排查..."

  "当用户让我帮忙 code review 时：
   1. 先了解项目结构
   2. 重点检查安全性（SQL注入、XSS等）
   3. 检查代码可读性和命名规范..."

5.2 The Core Value of Skills

没有 Skills：
第 1 次：用户让我做 X → 我摸索着做，花了 30 分钟
第 2 次：用户让我做 X → 我又重新摸索，又花了 30 分钟
第 N 次：每次都要重新摸索

有 Skills：
第 1 次：用户让我做 X → 我摸索着做，成功
       → 我把经验存成 skill_python_debug.md
第 2 次：用户让我做 X → 找到 skill_python_debug.md
       → 按步骤做，花了 5 分钟
第 N 次：Skills 越来越完善，做得越来越快

5.3 Skills vs. Ordinary Tools

DimensionOrdinary ToolsSkills
CreatorDevelopers write codeAgents extract them from their own experience
ContentPrecise operational stepsHeuristic guidance from experience
TriggerCalled directly by the AI modelThe model decides whether to load them based on the situation
GranularityPrecise down to function parametersCoarse-grained and organized by scenario

6. Skill Storage Format

6.1 Skills Directory Structure

~/.hermes/skills/
├── python-debug/
│   └── SKILL.md          ← 一个 Skill
├── code-review/
│   └── SKILL.md
├── research/
│   └── SKILL.md
└── ...

6.2 SKILL.md Format

Each Skill is a Markdown file containing a fixed set of sections:

# python-debug

## name
python-debug

## description
当用户描述 Python 错误、异常、或要求"帮我调试"时触发。
提供系统化的 Python 调试方法。

## trigger
用户说了以下关键词之一：
- "报错了"
- "出错了"
- "帮我看看"
- "调试"
- "traceback"
- "Exception"
- Python 相关的错误信息

## steps
1. **收集信息**
   - 让用户提供完整的错误信息（traceback）
   - 如果没有，提供重现步骤
   
2. **分析错误类型**
   - SyntaxError：检查拼写、缩进、括号匹配
   - ImportError：检查包是否安装、路径是否正确
   - IndexError / KeyError：检查边界和键名
   - TypeError：检查变量类型是否匹配
   - 自定义异常：追踪异常来源

3. **定位问题**
   - 从 traceback 最底部往上读
   - 找到第一个 "File" 行，那通常是问题所在
   - 注意 "in" 后面的函数名

4. **修复与验证**
   - 给出修复方案
   - 建议用户验证修复是否成功
   - 如果失败，继续分析

## notes
- 不要在看到完整 traceback 前就猜测原因
- Python 对缩进敏感，Tab 和空格混用是常见错误
- 虚拟环境没激活也会导致 ImportError

## examples
用户："Python 报错 ImportError: No module named 'requests'"
助手：
1. 检查是否安装了 requests：pip show requests
2. 如果没有，安装它：pip install requests
3. 如果安装了但还是报错，检查是否在正确的虚拟环境中

---
Created: 2025-03-20
Updated: 2025-03-24
Times used: 12

6.3 Skill Metadata

Besides the main SKILL.md file, many Skills contain additional files:

~/.hermes/skills/python-debug/
├── SKILL.md           ← 主文件（必须）
├── references/        ← 参考资料
│   └── python-error-codes.md
├── templates/         ← 代码模板
│   └── error_handler.py
└── scripts/           ← 辅助脚本
    └── analyze_traceback.py

7. Retrieving and Invoking Skills

7.1 When Are Skills Retrieved?

Skills are retrieved before every AIAgent decision:

用户消息进来
    │
    ▼
检索相关 Skills（基于关键词匹配）
    │
    ▼
找到相关 Skill → 把它的内容注入系统提示词
    │
    ▼
AIAgent 带着 Skill 指导继续工作

7.2 Retrieval Algorithm

# agent/skill_utils.py

def retrieve_skills(query: str, top_k: int = 3) -> List[Skill]:
    """
    根据用户查询检索最相关的 Skills。
    """
    # 1. 关键词匹配
    query_words = set(query.lower().split())
    
    scored = []
    for skill_path in list_skills():
        skill = load_skill(skill_path)
        
        # 计算关键词重叠度
        trigger_words = set(skill.trigger.lower().split())
        overlap = len(query_words & trigger_words)
        
        # 计算 TF-IDF 相似度（简化版）
        tfidf_score = compute_tfidf(query, skill.description)
        
        # 综合得分
        final_score = overlap * 2 + tfidf_score
        scored.append((final_score, skill))
    
    # 2. 按得分排序
    scored.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # 3. 返回 Top K
    return [skill for _, skill in scored[:top_k]]

7.3 The Result of Skill Injection

用户："我的 Python 脚本报错了，能帮我看看吗？"

系统提示词中注入：
---
## Active Skills

### [python-debug] (relevance: 0.95)
当用户描述 Python 错误时触发。

Steps:
1. 收集完整错误信息
2. 分析错误类型（SyntaxError/ImportError/IndexError/TypeError）
3. 从 traceback 底部往上看，找到第一个 File 行
4. 给出修复方案

Notes:
- 不要猜测，要先看完整 traceback
- 检查缩进、虚拟环境、包安装
---

AIAgent 看到用户"报错"，自动加载了 python-debug Skill，
按照 Skill 里的步骤引导用户提供信息，而不是乱猜。

8. How Skills Evolve

8.1 When Evolution Happens

Hermes decides whether a new Skill is worth creating after a task completes:

复杂任务完成（耗时 > 5 分钟，或工具调用 > 10 次）
    │
    ▼
Hermes 问自己：
"这次任务有什么值得以后复用的经验吗？"
    │
    ▼
如果有价值：
  → Hermes 自动创建/更新对应的 Skill
  → 增加使用次数计数
  → 更新 Last Updated 时间

8.2 Code for Automatic Evolution

# tools/skill_manager_tool.py

async def check_and_evolve_skills(
    task_description: str,
    conversation_history: List[dict],
    outcome: str,
):
    """
    检查是否需要从这次任务中提取新经验。
    """
    # 1. 判断任务复杂度
    if len(conversation_history) < 5:
        return  # 任务太简单，不需要记录
    
    # 2. 判断是否有成功经验
    if "error" in outcome.lower() or "fail" in outcome.lower():
        return  # 失败的任务不提取
    
    # 3. 让 AI 自己判断是否值得创建 Skill
    should_create = await ask_llm(
        f"""
        用户刚才完成了这个任务：
        {task_description}
        
        这次任务的成功经验是否值得以后复用？
        如果值得，应该怎么总结成步骤？
        """
    )
    
    if should_create["worth_saving"]:
        # 4. 创建或更新 Skill
        skill = build_skill_from_conversation(
            task_description,
            should_create["steps"],
            should_create["trigger_keywords"],
        )
        save_skill(skill)

8.3 A Skill's Lifecycle

创建（Create）
    │
    ▼
首次使用（First Use）
    │
    ▼
重复使用（Repeated Use）
    │
    ▼
遇到问题 → 修正 Skill（Refine）
    │
    ▼
越来越完善 → 成为"专家级"Skill

9. Memory vs. Skills: Comparison

DimensionMemorySkills
Stored contentFacts, such as Eva liking hot potExperience, such as how to debug Python
CreationThe user says "remember," or information is extracted automaticallyThe agent automatically distills experience from tasks
PurposeHelp AI know who the user isHelp AI perform better on similar problems
Update frequencyAs neededPotentially after every relevant task
File format~/.hermes/memory/*.md~/.hermes/skills/*/SKILL.md
Recall methodInjected at the start of every conversationRetrieved on demand and injected when matched
AnalogyA person's memoryA person's skills handbook or experience notes

Summary

By now, you should understand:

  • The fatal flaw of traditional agents: no persistent memory
  • The three-layer architecture of Hermes memory
  • The memory storage format: Markdown files
  • When and how memory recall happens
  • The fundamental difference between Memory and Skills
  • The Markdown format for Skills
  • Skill retrieval and injection
  • How self-evolving Skills automatically extract experience
  • A complete comparison of Memory and Skills

Originally published on the Preface Lab WeChat official account: Read the original article on WeChat.

title: Hermes Agent Tutorial (6): A Deep Dive into Subagents and Parallel Execution
html:
A Deep Dive into Hermes Subagents and Parallel Execution

Chapter goal: Understand how Hermes uses subagents for parallel tasks and how delegate_tool is designed
Prerequisites: Hermes Agent Tutorial (2): System Architecture and Design
Documentation: https://github.com/Eva-Dengyh/AI-Fullstack-Notes

Contents

  • 1. What problems do subagents solve?
  • 2. What is a subagent?
  • 3. The design of delegate_tool
  • 4. A subagent's lifecycle
  • 5. Parallel execution: Multiple subagents working together
  • 6. Tool-call flow: Main agent ↔ Subagent
  • 7. Resource isolation and safety
  • 8. Hands-on: Have Hermes research three topics simultaneously

1. What problems do subagents solve?

1.1 The single-agent bottleneck

A standard AIAgent works on one thread:

用户：帮我研究 AI Agent 的最新发展

    AI 思考：需要搜索很多资料...
        │
        ▼
    搜索 ①：LangChain 最新动态
        │
        ▼ 等待结果
    分析 ①
    
    搜索 ②：AutoGen 最新动态
        │
        ▼ 等待结果
    分析 ②
    
    搜索 ③：CrewAI 最新动态
        │
        ▼ 等待结果
    分析 ③
    
    综合报告 → 返回用户

The problem: Search and analysis are sequential, so three topics take three times as long.

1.2 The subagent solution

Introduce multiple subagents working simultaneously:

用户：帮我研究 AI Agent 的最新发展

    主 Agent（你）
        │
        ├──▶ 子 Agent A：研究 LangChain
        │       搜索 ① → 分析 ①
        │
        ├──▶ 子 Agent B：研究 AutoGen
        │       搜索 ② → 分析 ②
        │
        └──▶ 子 Agent C：研究 CrewAI
                搜索 ③ → 分析 ③

    三个子 Agent 同时工作（并行）
        │
        ▼
    主 Agent 收集所有结果 → 综合报告 → 返回用户

Result: Researching three topics takes 1x rather than 3x the time.

2. What is a subagent?

2.1 Definition

A subagent is a complete AIAgent instance running in an independent context.

主 Agent（父）
    │
    ├── 共享：主 Agent 的 session_id（用于共享历史）
    ├── 独立：自己的 AIAgent 实例
    ├── 独立：自己的 messages[] 历史
    ├── 独立：自己的 task_id（用于隔离工具状态）
    └── 独立：自己的 toolsets 配置

2.2 Subagents versus threads

People often confuse subagents with multithreading:

多线程：
  - 同一个进程里，多个执行流同时跑
  - 共享内存，有竞态条件风险
  - 一个崩溃可能影响其他

子 Agent：
  - 独立的 AIAgent 实例（进程级别隔离）
  - 完全独立的上下文
  - 一个崩溃不影响其他
  - 通信通过消息（JSON 字符串）

2.3 When to use subagents

ScenarioWhy use a subagent?
Research multiple topics at onceSpeed through parallelism
Handle subtasks in complex workTask decomposition and focus
Run risky operations that might failProtection through isolation
Tasks requiring different toolsetsIndependent configuration

3. The design of delegate_tool

3.1 Tool signature

# tools/delegate_tool.py

DELEGATE_SCHEMA = {
    "name": "delegate_task",
    "description": (
        "Spawn one or more subagents to work on tasks in isolated contexts. "
        "Each subagent gets its own conversation, terminal session, and toolset. "
        "Use for: reasoning-heavy subtasks, parallel independent workstreams, "
        "or tasks that would flood the main context with intermediate data.\n\n"
        "IMPORTANT: Subagents have NO memory of your conversation. "
        "Pass all relevant info (file paths, error messages, constraints) "
        "via the 'context' field."
    ),
    "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "goal": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "What the subagent should accomplish."
            },
            "context": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Background info the subagent needs."
            },
            "toolsets": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {"type": "string"},
                "description": "Toolsets to enable for this subagent."
            },
            "tasks": {
                "type": "array",
                "description": "Batch mode: tasks to run in parallel (up to 3).",
                "items": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                        "goal": {...},
                        "context": {...},
                        "toolsets": {...},
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

3.2 Core logic of delegate_tool

# tools/delegate_tool.py（简化版）

def delegate_task(
    goal: str = None,
    context: str = None,
    toolsets: List[str] = None,
    tasks: List[dict] = None,
    # 以下参数由框架注入
    task_id: str = None,
    session_id: str = None,
) -> str:
    """
    创建子 Agent 并执行任务。
    """
    
    # ========== 单任务模式 ==========
    if goal and not tasks:
        subagent = AIAgent(
            session_id=f"{session_id}:subagent:{task_id}",
            enabled_toolsets=toolsets or ["terminal", "file", "web"],
        )
        
        result = subagent.run_conversation(
            user_message=goal,
            system_message=f"Context: {context}" if context else None,
        )
        
        return json.dumps({
            "success": True,
            "result": result["final_response"],
        })
    
    # ========== 批量并行模式 ==========
    if tasks:
        # 并行执行多个子任务
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as executor:
            futures = []
            for i, task in enumerate(tasks):
                future = executor.submit(
                    run_subagent, task, i, session_id
                )
                futures.append(future)
            
            # 等待所有完成
            results = [f.result() for f in futures]
        
        return json.dumps({
            "success": True,
            "results": results,
        })

3.3 Batch mode: Parallel tasks

# 批量模式的实现

async def run_subagent_batch(tasks: List[dict]) -> List[str]:
    """
    同时启动多个子 Agent，结果一起返回。
    这是 Hermes 实现"同时研究 3 个主题"的核心。
    """
    
    async def run_one(task: dict, index: int):
        subagent = AIAgent(
            session_id=f"batch:{session_id}:{index}",
            enabled_toolsets=task.get("toolsets", ["terminal", "file", "web"]),
        )
        
        return await subagent.run_conversation_async(
            user_message=task["goal"],
            system_message=f"Background: {task.get('context', '')}",
        )
    
    # asyncio.gather 同时运行所有任务
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        *[run_one(t, i) for i, t in enumerate(tasks)]
    )
    
    return results

4. A subagent's lifecycle

4.1 Complete lifecycle diagram

主 Agent
    │
    │ ① delegate_task("帮我研究 X", tasks=[A, B, C])
    ▼
子 Agent A  子 Agent B  子 Agent C
    │          │          │
    │ ② 创建   │  ③ 创建   │  ④ 创建
    │ AIAgent │  AIAgent │  AIAgent
    │ 实例     │  实例     │  实例
    │          │          │
    │ ⑤ 运行   │  ⑤ 运行   │  ⑤ 运行
    │ run_conv │  run_conv │  run_conv
    │          │          │
    │ ⑥ 返回   │  ⑥ 返回   │  ⑥ 返回
    │ 结果     │  结果     │  结果
    │          │          │
    └──────────┼──────────┘
               │
               ▼
         ⑦ 主 Agent 收集所有结果
               │
               ▼
         ⑧ 综合成最终回复
               │
               ▼
         ⑨ 返回给用户

4.2 Lifecycle in detail

① 创建子 Agent
   - 主 Agent 调用 delegate_task
   - 框架创建一个全新的 AIAgent 实例
   - 每个子 Agent 有自己的 task_id

② 初始化上下文
   - 子 Agent 加载自己的 system prompt
   - 如果传入了 context，作为 system message 注入
   - 子 Agent 不知道主 Agent 聊过什么

③ 运行 run_conversation
   - 子 Agent 独立执行 AI 循环
   - 可以调用工具，可以多轮交互
   - 有自己的 iteration_budget

④ 返回结果
   - 子 Agent 返回 final_response
   - 结果以 JSON 字符串形式返回给主 Agent
   - 主 Agent 把结果注入自己的 messages

⑤ 主 Agent 继续工作
   - 主 Agent 看到子 Agent 的结果
   - 综合所有子 Agent 的研究，生成最终报告

4.3 State isolation

The subagent and main agent are fully isolated:

# 隔离维度：

# 消息历史（messages[]）
主 Agent messages ≠ 子 Agent messages
  → 子 Agent 不会看到主 Agent 的完整对话历史

# 工具状态
子 Agent 有独立的 task_id
  → 子 Agent 的文件操作不会污染主 Agent 的工作目录

# 工具集（toolsets）
子 Agent 可以有不同的工具集
  → 可以限制子 Agent 只能搜索，不能写文件

# Token 预算
每个子 Agent 有自己的 iteration_budget
  → 一个子 Agent 失控不会耗尽主 Agent 的预算

5. Parallel execution: Multiple subagents working together

5.1 Why parallelize?

Running three subagents sequentially:

任务 A：10 分钟
任务 B：10 分钟
任务 C：10 分钟
─────────────────
总耗时：30 分钟

Running three subagents in parallel:

子A：10分钟 ──────────────────▶
子B：10分钟 ──────────────────▶
子C：10分钟 ──────────────────▶
─────────────────
总耗时：10 分钟

5.2 Conditions for parallel execution

Parallelism is not universal. It suits the following situations:

适合并行：
  ✅ 三个任务相互独立（研究 A、研究 B、研究 C）
  ✅ 三个任务不需要互相通信
  ✅ 三个任务使用不同的工具

不适合并行：
  ❌ 任务 B 需要等任务 A 的结果
  ❌ 三个任务要访问同一个文件
  ❌ 三个任务有执行顺序依赖

5.3 Using batch mode

# 批量并行模式的调用方式

delegate_task(
    tasks=[
        {
            "goal": "深入研究 LangChain 的最新发展",
            "context": "重点关注：1) 新特性 2) 性能改进 3) 已知问题",
            "toolsets": ["web", "terminal"],
        },
        {
            "goal": "深入研究 AutoGen 的最新发展",
            "context": "重点关注：1) 多 Agent 协作 2) 代码生成能力",
            "toolsets": ["web", "terminal"],
        },
        {
            "goal": "深入研究 CrewAI 的最新发展",
            "context": "重点关注：1) Agent 角色定义 2) 任务分解能力",
            "toolsets": ["web", "terminal"],
        },
    ]
)
# → 三个子 Agent 同时启动
# → 10 分钟后，三个结果一起返回
# → 主 Agent 综合成报告

5.4 Technical implementation of parallel execution

# ThreadPoolExecutor 实现真正的并行

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as executor:
    
    def run_subagent_in_thread(task: dict, index: int):
        """在新线程里运行子 Agent"""
        subagent = AIAgent(
            session_id=f"{session_id}:child:{index}",
            enabled_toolsets=task.get("toolsets", ["terminal", "file", "web"]),
        )
        
        return subagent.run_conversation(
            user_message=task["goal"],
            system_message=task.get("context"),
        )
    
    futures = [
        executor.submit(run_subagent_in_thread, task, i)
        for i, task in enumerate(tasks)
    ]
    
    # gather 等待所有线程完成
    results = [f.result() for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures)]

6. Tool-call flow: Main agent ↔ Subagent

6.1 Can subagents call tools?

Yes. A subagent is a full AIAgent with its own toolset.

子 Agent A
    │
    │ user_message: "搜索 LangChain 最新动态"
    ▼
AI 思考："需要调用 web_search 工具"
    │
    ▼
web_search(query="LangChain latest news 2025")
    │
    ▼
返回搜索结果

6.2 Subagent tool restrictions

The main agent can restrict which tools a subagent may use:

delegate_task(
    goal="帮我分析这个代码库",
    context="代码库路径：~/project",
    toolsets=["file", "terminal"],  # 没有 "delegate"！
                                    # 子 Agent 不能创建更多子 Agent
)

This is an intentional safeguard against subagents spawning endlessly and exhausting resources.

6.3 Communication between main agent and subagent

主 Agent                          子 Agent
    │                                  │
    │  ① delegate_task(goal, context)  │
    │ ─────────────────────────────────▶
    │                                  │
    │                           ② 构建自己的消息
    │                           ③ AI 循环（可调用工具）
    │                                  │
    │                           ④ 返回最终回复
    │ ◀─────────────────────────────────
    │                                  │
    │  ⑤ 主 Agent 把子 Agent 的回复   │
    │     注入自己的 messages[]        │
    │                                  │
    ▼  ⑥ 主 Agent 继续工作            │

7. Resource isolation and safety

7.1 Why isolate?

场景：
  子 Agent A 执行了一个有风险的命令：
  rm -rf /important/project
  
  如果没有隔离，这个命令会删除主 Agent 工作目录的文件！

解决方案：
  每个子 Agent 运行在独立的 task_id 下
  → 文件操作被限制在 task_id 对应的目录
  → 危险的 rm -rf 不会影响到主目录

7.2 Process-level isolation

# 子 Agent 的创建可以指定不同的运行环境

subagent = AIAgent(
    session_id=f"{session_id}:child:{index}",
    
    # 指定运行环境
    backend="docker",           # 在 Docker 容器里运行
    docker_image="hermes/agent", # 使用隔离的 Docker 镜像
    # 不指定则默认在本地运行
    
    enabled_toolsets=["terminal", "file", "web"],
)

7.3 Tool-level safety

# 子 Agent 不能调用的工具（在注册时标记）

AGENT_LOOP_TOOLS = {
    "delegate_task",     # 子 Agent 不能创建更多子 Agent
    "memory_manage",    # 子 Agent 不能修改主人记忆
    "skill_manage",     # 子 Agent 不能修改 Skills
    "cronjob_manage",   # 子 Agent 不能创建定时任务
}

# 在 handle_function_call 中拦截
if function_name in _AGENT_LOOP_TOOLS:
    return json.dumps({
        "error": f"{function_name} must be handled by the agent loop"
    })

8. Hands-on: Have Hermes research three topics simultaneously

8.1 User scenario

用户："帮我同时研究这三个主题：
      1. 2025年 AI Agent 的最新发展趋势
      2. 最新发布的开源 LLM 模型
      3. Rust 语言在 AI 领域的应用"

预期：
  → 三个子 Agent 同时开始研究
  → 10 分钟后得到三份独立报告
  → 主 Agent 综合成一份完整报告

8.2 Complete conversation flow

用户
  │
  ▼
主 Agent 思考："这是三个独立的研究任务，
              我应该并行执行以节省时间"
  │
  ▼
delegate_task(tasks=[...])
  │
  ├──▶ 子 Agent A：研究 AI Agent 趋势
  │       │
  │       ▼ web_search("AI Agent trends 2025")
  │       ▼ 分析搜索结果
  │       ▼ 生成报告
  │       ▼ 返回："AI Agent 2025 趋势报告..."
  │
  ├──▶ 子 Agent B：研究开源 LLM
  │       │
  │       ▼ web_search("latest open source LLM 2025")
  │       ▼ 分析搜索结果
  │       ▼ 生成报告
  │       ▼ 返回："最新开源 LLM 报告..."
  │
  └──▶ 子 Agent C：研究 Rust + AI
          │
          ▼ web_search("Rust AI applications 2025")
          ▼ 分析搜索结果
          ▼ 生成报告
          ▼ 返回："Rust AI 应用报告..."

  （三个子 Agent 同时运行）
  │
  ▼
主 Agent 收到三个报告
  │
  ▼
综合成最终报告，返回给用户

8.3 Comparing actual results

ApproachTimeExperience
One agent, sequential30 minutes (3 × 10)Long wait
Three subagents, parallel10 minutesAll results arrive quickly

Summary

After this chapter, you should understand:

  • The single-agent bottleneck: Slow sequential processing
  • The definition of a subagent: An independent AIAgent instance
  • The fundamental difference between subagents and multithreading
  • The design of delegate_tool: Single-task and batch-parallel modes
  • The complete subagent lifecycle: Create → Run → Return → Synthesize
  • Four dimensions of state isolation: Messages / tools / toolsets / budgets
  • Conditions and suitable scenarios for parallel execution
  • Resource isolation and safety mechanisms
  • Hands-on: Researching several topics simultaneously

title: Hermes Agent Tutorial (7): Building a Custom Tool
html:
Hands-on: Adding a Custom Tool to Hermes

Chapter objective: Learn the complete process of adding a new tool to Hermes through a full practical example
Prerequisites: Hermes Agent Tutorial (3): A Deep Dive into the Tool System
Documentation: https://github.com/Eva-Dengyh/AI-Fullstack-Notes

Contents

  • 1. Objectives and Prerequisites
  • 2. Tool Design: From Requirements to Schema
  • 3. Step One: Create the Tool File
  • 4. Step Two: Implement the Handler
  • 5. Step Three: Register with the Tool System
  • 6. Step Four: Add to the Discovery List
  • 7. Step Five: Verify Tool Availability
  • 8. Complete Code
  • 9. Common Issues and Debugging
  • 10. Apply What You Learned: More Tool Examples

1. Objectives and Prerequisites

1.1 Chapter Objectives

By creating a complete tool for a real requirement, learn:

✅ 如何设计一个工具的 Schema
✅ 如何实现 Handler 的标准模式
✅ 如何注册工具到 Hermes
✅ 如何验证工具正常工作

1.2 The Tool We Will Build

currency_convert tool: currency conversion

输入：amount（金额）、from_currency（源货币）、to_currency（目标货币）
输出：转换后的金额、汇率、转换时间

示例：
  用户：100 美元换成人民币是多少？
  工具调用：currency_convert(amount=100, from_currency="USD", to_currency="CNY")
  返回：{"success": true, "amount": 725.50, "rate": 7.255, "from": "USD", "to": "CNY"}
  Hermes 回复："100 美元 = 725.50 人民币（汇率 1:7.255）"

1.3 Prerequisites

Make sure your Hermes environment runs correctly:

cd ~/code/hermes-agent
source .venv/bin/activate
python -c "from tools.registry import registry; print('Registry OK')"

2. Tool Design: From Requirements to Schema

2.1 First: Define the Tool's Responsibilities

Tool name:currency_convert

What the tool does: Converts one currency into another using current exchange rates

What the tool does not do (boundaries):

  • ❌ No historical exchange-rate queries
  • ❌ No simultaneous multi-currency conversion (only two currencies per call)
  • ❌ No cryptocurrencies (the free API does not support them)

2.2 Second: Design the Schema

The schema is the “instruction manual” the AI model reads:

CURRENCY_CONVERT_SCHEMA = {
    "name": "currency_convert",
    "description": (
        "Convert an amount from one currency to another using real-time exchange rates.\n\n"
        "Use when: user asks about currency conversion, exchange rates, "
        "how much is X in Y currency, etc.\n\n"
        "Source: ExchangeRate-API (free tier, no API key required for basic use).\n\n"
        "Supported currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, AUD, CAD, CHF, INR, ..."
    ),
    "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "amount": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": (
                    "The amount of money to convert. "
                    "Example: 100, 50.5, 1000"
                )
            },
            "from_currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": (
                    "Source currency code (3-letter ISO 4217). "
                    "Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, AUD, CAD"
                )
            },
            "to_currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": (
                    "Target currency code (3-letter ISO 4217). "
                    "Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, AUD, CAD"
                )
            }
        },
        "required": ["amount", "from_currency", "to_currency"]
    }
}

2.3 Design Considerations

The schema description should include:

  • The scenarios in which to use the tool (“when the user asks about currency conversion”)
  • The tool's accepted parameters (parameter names, types, and meanings)
  • The tool's return values (so the AI model knows how to interpret results)
  • Limitations (what is unsupported, to prevent misuse by the AI)

The schema description should not include:

  • Internal implementation details (the AI does not need them)
  • Specific error-handling logic (the handler is responsible for this)

3. Step One: Create the Tool File

3.1 File Naming Conventions

tools/
├── currency_convert_tool.py  ← 工具文件名
└── ...

Naming conventions:

  • Use lowercase letters joined by underscores
  • End with _tool.py
  • Match the tool name (currency_convert → currency_convert_tool.py)

3.2 File Structure Template

Every tool file follows a consistent structure:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
[工具名称] Tool Module

[简短描述工具功能]

Usage:
    [如果用户想直接调用，怎么用]
"""

import json
import urllib.request
from typing import Dict, Any

# ============================================================
# Schema：给 AI 模型看的说明书
# ============================================================

CURRENCY_CONVERT_SCHEMA = {
    # ...（见上一节）
}

# ============================================================
# 可用性检查
# ============================================================

def check_currency_convert_requirements() -> bool:
    """货币转换工具始终可用（使用免费公开 API）"""
    return True

# ============================================================
# Handler：真正做事的函数
# ============================================================

def currency_convert_handler(args: dict, **kwargs) -> str:
    """
    将一种货币转换为另一种货币。
    
    Args:
        args: 包含 amount, from_currency, to_currency
        **kwargs: task_id 等额外参数
    
    Returns:
        JSON 字符串
    """
    pass  # 下一节实现

# ============================================================
# 注册到全局注册表
# ============================================================

from tools.registry import registry

registry.register(
    name="currency_convert",
    toolset="web",  # 货币转换依赖网络，放在 web 工具集
    schema=CURRENCY_CONVERT_SCHEMA,
    handler=lambda args, **kw: currency_convert_handler(args, **kw),
    check_fn=check_currency_convert_requirements,
    emoji="💱",
)

4. Step Two: Implement the Handler

4.1 Standard Handler Signature

def my_handler(args: dict, **kwargs) -> str:
    """
    Args:
        args: 工具调用时传递的参数（字典）
            - 由 AI 模型根据 Schema 推断生成
            - 类型已经在 Schema 中声明
            
        **kwargs: 框架注入的额外上下文
            - task_id: str      # 用于工具内部的状态隔离
            - session_id: str   # 会话 ID
            - tool_call_id: str # 工具调用 ID（用于日志追踪）
    
    Returns:
        str: JSON 字符串（必须是字符串！）
    """

4.2 The Complete currency_convert_handler

def currency_convert_handler(args: dict, **kwargs) -> str:
    """
    货币转换 Handler。
    """
    
    # ========== 第1步：解析参数 ==========
    amount = args.get("amount")
    from_currency = args.get("from_currency", "").upper().strip()
    to_currency = args.get("to_currency", "").upper().strip()
    
    # 参数验证
    if amount is None or amount == "":
        return json.dumps({"error": "Amount is required"})
    
    try:
        amount = float(amount)
        if amount < 0:
            return json.dumps({"error": "Amount must be positive"})
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return json.dumps({"error": f"Invalid amount: {amount}"})
    
    if not from_currency:
        return json.dumps({"error": "from_currency is required"})
    
    if not to_currency:
        return json.dumps({"error": "to_currency is required"})
    
    # ========== 第2步：调用外部 API ==========
    try:
        # 使用 exchangerate-api.com 的免费 API
        # 不需要 API key（免费额度足够日常使用）
        url = f"https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/{from_currency}"
        
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            headers={"User-Agent": "Hermes-Agent/1.0"}
        )
        
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as response:
            data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        
        # 检查 API 返回状态
        if data.get("result") != "success":
            return json.dumps({
                "error": "Exchange rate API returned an error"
            })
        
        rates = data.get("rates", {})
        rate = rates.get(to_currency)
        
        if rate is None:
            return json.dumps({
                "error": f"Currency '{to_currency}' not supported"
            })
        
        # ========== 第3步：计算结果 ==========
        converted_amount = round(amount * rate, 2)
        
        # ========== 第4步：返回 JSON 字符串 ==========
        return json.dumps({
            "success": True,
            "from": from_currency,
            "to": to_currency,
            "amount": amount,
            "converted_amount": converted_amount,
            "rate": rate,
            "time": data.get("time", ""),
        })
    
    except urllib.error.URLError as e:
        return json.dumps({
            "error": f"Network error: could not fetch exchange rate. "
                     f"Please check your internet connection."
        })
    except Exception as e:
        return json.dumps({
            "error": f"Failed to convert currency: {str(e)}"
        })

4.3 The Handler's Three Required Parts

def handler(args, **kwargs) -> str:
    
    # 1. 参数解析和验证
    #    - 检查必填参数
    #    - 类型转换（字符串 → 数字等）
    #    - 非法参数返回错误 JSON
    params = parse_and_validate(args)
    
    # 2. 实际业务逻辑
    #    - 调用外部 API / 读写文件 / 执行命令
    #    - 各种异常处理
    result = do_the_work(params)
    
    # 3. 返回 JSON 字符串
    #    - 必须是字符串！
    #    - 成功：包含结果数据
    #    - 失败：包含错误信息
    return json.dumps(result)

5. Step Three: Register with the Tool System

5.1 Registration Code

Add this at the end of the file, after all function definitions:

# tools/currency_convert_tool.py 末尾

from tools.registry import registry

registry.register(
    name="currency_convert",
    toolset="web",  # 货币转换放在 web 工具集（依赖网络）
    schema=CURRENCY_CONVERT_SCHEMA,
    handler=lambda args, **kw: currency_convert_handler(args, **kw),
    check_fn=check_currency_convert_requirements,
    emoji="💱",
)

5.2 Registration Parameters Explained

ParameterMeaningHow to fill it in
nameTool name (the name the AI calls)String, lowercase with underscores
toolsetThe toolset it belongs to“web” / “file” / “terminal”, etc.
schemaInstructions visible to the AIThe dictionary designed earlier
handlerThe function that actually executesWrapped in a lambda
check_fnAvailability-check functionReturn True if there are no dependencies
emojiIcon displayed in the UIOptional, for appearance

6. Step Four: Add to the Discovery List

6.1 Find the Discovery List

model_tools.py contains the _discover_tools() function, which maintains the list of all tool modules:

# model_tools.py

def _discover_tools():
    _modules = [
        "tools.ansi_strip",
        "tools.binary_extensions",
        # ... 已有 60+ 个 ...
        # 在这里添加新工具
    ]

6.2 Add the New Tool

Open model_tools.py, find the _modules list, and add the new tool anywhere:

# model_tools.py 约第 138 行附近

_modules = [
    # ... 其他工具 ...
    "tools.cronjob_tools",
    "tools.currency_convert_tool",  # ← 添加这一行
    "tools.debug_helpers",
    # ... 其他工具 ...
]

7. Step Five: Verify Tool Availability

7.1 Quick Verification (Interactive Python)

# 在终端中运行

cd ~/code/hermes-agent
source .venv/bin/activate
python

>>> from model_tools import handle_function_call
>>> result = handle_function_call(
...     "currency_convert",
...     {"amount": 100, "from_currency": "USD", "to_currency": "CNY"}
... )
>>> print(result)

Expected output:

{"success": true, "from": "USD", "to": "CNY", "amount": 100.0, "converted_amount": 725.5, "rate": 7.255, "time": "2025-03-25 12:00:00 UTC"}

7.2 Verify in Hermes

重启 Hermes（新会话生效）

用户：100美元换成人民币是多少？
  │
  ▼
Hermes AI 调用 currency_convert
  │
  ▼
返回结果给 AI
  │
  ▼
Hermes 回复：
"根据最新汇率，100 美元 = 725.50 人民币（1 USD = 7.255 CNY）"

8. Complete Code

Here is the complete code for tools/currency_convert_tool.py:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Currency Convert Tool Module

Convert an amount from one currency to another using real-time exchange rates.
Uses the free exchangerate-api.com API (no API key required).

Usage:
    currency_convert(amount=100, from_currency="USD", to_currency="CNY")
"""

import json
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Any

# ============================================================
# Schema：给 AI 模型看的说明书
# ============================================================

CURRENCY_CONVERT_SCHEMA = {
    "name": "currency_convert",
    "description": (
        "Convert an amount from one currency to another using real-time exchange rates.\n\n"
        "Use when: user asks about currency conversion, exchange rates, "
        "how much is X in Y currency, etc.\n\n"
        "Source: ExchangeRate-API (free tier, no API key required).\n\n"
        "Supported currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, AUD, CAD, CHF, INR, SGD, ..."
    ),
    "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "amount": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": (
                    "The amount of money to convert. "
                    "Example: 100, 50.5, 1000"
                )
            },
            "from_currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": (
                    "Source currency code (3-letter ISO 4217). "
                    "Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, AUD, CAD"
                )
            },
            "to_currency": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": (
                    "Target currency code (3-letter ISO 4217). "
                    "Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY, KRW, AUD, CAD"
                )
            }
        },
        "required": ["amount", "from_currency", "to_currency"]
    }
}

# ============================================================
# 可用性检查
# ============================================================

def check_currency_convert_requirements() -> bool:
    """货币转换工具始终可用（使用免费公开 API）"""
    return True

# ============================================================
# Handler：真正做事的函数
# ============================================================

def currency_convert_handler(args: dict, **kwargs) -> str:
    """
    将一种货币转换为另一种货币。
    
    Args:
        args: 包含 amount, from_currency, to_currency
        **kwargs: task_id 等额外参数
    
    Returns:
        JSON 字符串
    """
    
    # ========== 第1步：解析参数 ==========
    amount = args.get("amount")
    from_currency = args.get("from_currency", "").upper().strip()
    to_currency = args.get("to_currency", "").upper().strip()
    
    # 参数验证
    if amount is None or amount == "":
        return json.dumps({"error": "amount is required"})
    
    try:
        amount = float(amount)
        if amount < 0:
            return json.dumps({"error": "amount must be a positive number"})
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return json.dumps({"error": f"invalid amount: {amount}"})
    
    if not from_currency:
        return json.dumps({"error": "from_currency is required"})
    
    if not to_currency:
        return json.dumps({"error": "to_currency is required"})
    
    # ========== 第2步：调用外部 API ==========
    try:
        # 使用 exchangerate-api.com 的免费 API
        url = f"https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/{from_currency}"
        
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            headers={"User-Agent": "Hermes-Agent/1.0"}
        )
        
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as response:
            data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        
        # 检查 API 返回状态
        if data.get("result") != "success":
            return json.dumps({
                "error": "exchange rate API returned an error"
            })
        
        rates = data.get("rates", {})
        rate = rates.get(to_currency)
        
        if rate is None:
            return json.dumps({
                "error": f"currency '{to_currency}' is not supported"
            })
        
        # ========== 第3步：计算结果 ==========
        converted_amount = round(amount * rate, 2)
        
        # ========== 第4步：返回 JSON 字符串 ==========
        return json.dumps({
            "success": True,
            "from": from_currency,
            "to": to_currency,
            "amount": amount,
            "converted_amount": converted_amount,
            "rate": rate,
            "time": data.get("time", ""),
        })
    
    except urllib.error.URLError as e:
        return json.dumps({
            "error": f"network error: could not fetch exchange rate. "
                     f"please check your internet connection."
        })
    except Exception as e:
        return json.dumps({
            "error": f"failed to convert currency: {str(e)}"
        })

# ============================================================
# 注册到全局注册表
# ============================================================

from tools.registry import registry

registry.register(
    name="currency_convert",
    toolset="web",
    schema=CURRENCY_CONVERT_SCHEMA,
    handler=lambda args, **kw: currency_convert_handler(args, **kw),
    check_fn=check_currency_convert_requirements,
    emoji="💱",
)

9. Common Issues and Debugging

9.1 The Tool Is Registered but Hermes Says It Cannot Find It

Cause:model_tools.py's _modules list was not updated

Solution: Make sure the new module is added to the list in _discover_tools()

9.2 The Tool Call Succeeds but Returns “Unknown tool”

Cause: The handler threw an exception that was caught by registry.dispatch, which returned an error

Solution: Check whether the returned JSON contains an "error" field

9.3 The Schema Is Fine but the AI Does Not Call the Tool

Cause: The schema's description does not clearly explain when to use it

Solution: Add "Use when: ..." at the start of the description to explain the triggering scenario

9.4 Debugging Tips

# 在 handler 里加日志
import logging
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def currency_convert_handler(args, **kwargs):
    logger.info(f"currency_convert called with: {args}")
    try:
        result = do_convert(args)
        logger.info(f"Result: {result}")
        return json.dumps(result)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error: {e}")
        raise  # 重新抛出，让 registry.dispatch 处理

10. Apply What You Learned: More Tool Examples

10.1 Tool: Unit Conversion (Length/Weight/Temperature)

UNIT_CONVERT_SCHEMA = {
    "name": "unit_convert",
    "description": "Convert between units of measurement...",
    "parameters": {
        "properties": {
            "value": {"type": "number"},
            "from_unit": {"type": "string", "enum": ["km", "miles", "kg", "lbs", ...]},
            "to_unit": {"type": "string", "enum": ["km", "miles", "kg", "lbs", ...]},
        }
    }
}

10.2 Tool: Calculator (Expression Support)

CALCULATE_SCHEMA = {
    "name": "calculate",
    "description": "Evaluate a mathematical expression...",
    "parameters": {
        "properties": {
            "expression": {"type": "string", "description": "Math expression, e.g. '2+2*3'"}
        }
    }
}

def calculate_handler(args):
    import math  # 可以用 math 库做复杂计算
    expression = args["expression"]
    # 安全评估（只用 ast.parse 检查语法，不执行）
    result = safe_eval(expression)
    return json.dumps({"result": result})

10.3 Tool: Quick Wikipedia Lookup

WIKIPEDIA_SCHEMA = {
    "name": "wikipedia_lookup",
    "description": "Quickly look up a topic on Wikipedia...",
    "parameters": {
        "properties": {
            "query": {"type": "string"}
        }
    }
}

Summary

By the end of this chapter, you should know:

  • How to design a tool from requirements
  • How to write a schema that follows the conventions
  • How to implement the standard three-step handler pattern
  • How to register a tool with Hermes
  • How to add it to the discovery list
  • How to verify that the tool works
  • How to debug common problems

Tutorial Series Wrap-Up

Congratulations on completing the series! You should now have a full understanding of Hermes Agent:

第一章：本地启动及项目结构
第二章：系统架构全景图
第三章：工具系统深度解析
第四章：Gateway 消息流深度解析
第五章：记忆与 Skills 系统深度解析
第六章：子 Agent 与并行执行深度解析
第七章：实践——添加自定义工具

You have learned Hermes Agent's core design philosophy and how its major modules work.
